name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. domain=chapter; 'ch08' is the meaningful chapter id (chapters 01-30), NOT Ghidra address residue (its address is 0x520ff). 'end_scene_char_pos_x_table' accurately describes purpose and reflects the data type (table). Consistent with sibling tables (ch03/ch05/ch07/ch10/ch12) in chtab.c. No hex suffix matching its own or any data address.
purpose: Chapter 8 end-scene character placement: per-character battle-tile X tile coordinate for the 10 characters staged in the chapter-8 recruit cutscene (recruit char #5, knight Lona / 騎士洛娜).
logic_summary: Read-only const byte[10] in .object2. The sole caller fd2_chapter_08_end (@0x234BB: MOV ESI,0x520FF; MOVSD/MOVSD/MOVSW) block-copies all 10 bytes onto an on-stack scene block and passes it as the X-position argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro (@0x233C6). Each entry is consumed one byte at a time (no struct stride, no wider element access, no sign extension). Paired with the Y table @0x52109; sprite facing is an inline fixed value (2) in the caller, so there is no facing table.
element_semantics: Per-character battle-tile X coordinate (one byte per staged character, 10 characters). Observed values 11..17.
notes: src comment block (chtab.c lines 406-427) is already precise, accurate, ASCII -> kept unchanged. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT for this symbol was blank (descriptive text only lived in PRE_COMMENT, contrary to the project data-plate convention which requires PLATE_COMMENT); created a concise correct PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline and saved. Left the pre-existing PRE_COMMENT in place (its duplication is pre-existing across many sibling tables in this binary and a broader cleanup is out of scope for this single symbol). Verified zero writers (single READ + DATA xref from fd2_chapter_08_end) -> const confirmed.
